title: Measurement and Pythagoras' theorem
summary: Perimeter, circumference, area of quadrilaterals, circles and sectors, surface area, volume and capacity, time zones, and Pythagoras' theorem.

cards.title: Length and perimeter
cards.rule: Perimeter is the distance around the outside.

cards.title: Special quadrilaterals
cards.rule: Parallelogram \(bh\). Rhombus or kite \(\tfrac12 xy\). Trapezium \(\tfrac12(a + b)h\).

cards.title: Area of circles
cards.rule: \(A = \pi r^2\). Use the radius, half the diameter.
cards.tip: \(\pi r^2\) is area, \(2\pi r\) is circumference.

cards.title: Sectors and composite shapes
cards.rule: Sector: \(\tfrac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2\). Composite: split into shapes you know, then add or take away.
lines: 8 by 4 rectangle with a semicircle on the 4 side: \(32 + \tfrac12\pi(2^2) \approx 38.3\)

cards.title: Surface area of prisms
cards.rule: Add the areas of every face. Drawing the net helps.

cards.title: Volume and capacity
lines: 1 cm³ = 1 mL, 1000 cm³ = 1 L, 1 m³ = 1000 L

cards.title: Time and time zones
cards.rule: Going west, clocks are earlier. Going east, clocks are later.
lines: Melbourne is UTC+10, Perth is UTC+8
3 pm in Melbourne is **1 pm** in Perth (standard time)
cards.tip: daylight saving changes the gap in summer.

cards.title: Pythagoras' theorem
cards.rule: Right-angled triangles: \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2\), \(c\) is the hypotenuse.

cards.title: Finding a shorter side
cards.tip: a shorter side can never be longer than the hypotenuse.
